description: This file implements modulation mapping functions for various modulation schemes, including lookup tables for QAM and BPSK, and functions to modulate bits into complex symbols with scaling. It defines template classes for modulation tables, specific classes for BPSK and π/2-BPSK, and functions to perform modulation based on scheme.

classes.name: modulator_table_s
classes.description: Template class for modulation lookup tables supporting various modulation orders (e.g., QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, 256-QAM). Handles table creation, scaling, and modulation of bits into symbols.

classes.name: modulator_table_bpsk
classes.description: Class for BPSK modulation lookup table, providing methods to modulate bits into complex symbols.

classes.name: modulator_table_pi_2_bpsk
classes.description: Class for π/2-BPSK modulation lookup table, providing methods to modulate bits into complex symbols with phase shifts.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Main function to modulate bits into symbols based on specified modulation scheme.

methods.name: get_modulation_scaling
methods.description: Returns the scaling factor for a given modulation scheme.

methods.name: modulate (overload for span<ci8_t>)
methods.description: Modulates bits into I/Q symbols with scaling, for 8-bit complex output.
